args.title: Fix password reset email link to use the correct base URL
args.body: Issue 4201 reports that the password reset email contains a link to the localhost URL. The current implementation in src/notifications/templates.ts sets the BASE_URL to "http://localhost:3000" if the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not defined. This causes the reset password link to point to localhost, which is not accessible to users. The proposed change involves updating the BASE_URL to either use PUBLIC_URL or an appropriate production URL to ensure users receive a valid link for resetting their password.
